precision: IEEE FP32; existing FP64 audit arithmetic retained

methodology.wall: One sequential unprofiled local pass. Parent/child wall timers include CPU work, GPU work and synchronization. Uninstrumented components are left as explicit remainders.
methodology.teacher_gpu: Separate exact teacher replay. Each kernel belongs to one function-name group. GPU times are not added to wall or host API times.
methodology.update_gpu: Separate exact final trainer replay. Means over 2,048 graph executions, grouped in captured-node order and checked against the source call sequence.
methodology.limits: Shared RTX 2080; one pass, no confidence interval. Eight requested states per condition plus six preceding states. One diagnostic audit after this pass; the long cycle normally audits every 30 minutes and adapts states up to 64. This profile does not establish quality improvement or long-run time shares.
